title: The Fake Semester
author: Rosalind Reyes
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
